rules.gross_sale_copper: BeanCounter money - deposit + fee; accepted only when equal to recorded buyout.
rules.unit_price: Gross completed-buyout copper divided by stack size.
rules.gear_medium_gate: At least 4 completed buyouts, 2 distinct buyers, and 2 distinct UTC days, with largest buyer unit share at most 0.50.
rules.gear_stronger_medium_coverage: At least 8 completed buyouts, 4 distinct buyers, and 4 distinct UTC days, while still passing the medium concentration gate.
rules.comparison_retry_rule: After the initial batch, wait 2, 5, and 10 seconds and retry only failed comparison requests before recording a final failure.
